questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Please explain: *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Dels at de kurser som skulle erstatte de på KU var interessante og dels at jeg kunne opleve noget i min fritid

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Det var både ret let at få hjælp inden og under opholdet. Både omkring kurser hvor Toril Salen på UiB var behjælpelig med at besvare spørgsmål og andre ting såsom Sammen student housing.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Forud for opholdet fik jeg hjælp til at finde bolig gennem Sammen. Derudover var der en introduktion for alle udvekslingsstuderende og en introduktion for alle udvekslingsstuderende på det psykologiske fakultet.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: Jeg synes der manglede nogle ryste sammen-arrangemeneter. Der foregår mange arrangementer på Fantoft gennem Sammen, men hvis man ikke boede i en bolig gennem Sammen var der ikke noget.

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
What should future exchange students know about on campus housing? *
How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Det var ret nemt og fordelen var at jeg kunne bo mere centralt end på Fantoft.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Jeg kan dog ikke anbefale at finde en lejlighed selv da det er mit indtryk at det er nemmere at indgå i det sociale hvis man bor på Fantoft eller gennem Sammens andre boliger. Man må være mere opsøgende med det sociale hvis man bor for sig selv eller med roomies som jeg gjorde. Dog var det fedt at bo og få norske venner også.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Efter at have fået forhåndsgodkendelse fra KU kunne jeg i UiBs tilmeldingsperiode frem til februar tilmelde mig kurser.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Email korrespondence med Toril Salen på UiB

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Det gik helt fint

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Start I god tid hvis du får behov for at stille spørgsmål og der er behandlingstid

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Bachelorkurser er kurser fra 100-199 i emnekoden, og kurser med emnekoder fra 200-299 kan tages af både bachelor og kandidatstuderende og kurser med emnekoder fra 300-399 er for kandidatstuderende.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Der var mere seminarundervisning med færre studerende på holdet.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Culture, positive development & health, Psykologisk Behandling, Forskningspraksis 2, Love and close relationships

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your second semester. *
What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Psykologisk Behandling og Love and close relationships

questions.answer: Der er fx Studentersamfunnet som jeg blev en del af, hvor man også har mulighed for at møde nye mennesker.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Samme som ovenfor

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: De 7 fjelde i Bergen og så DNT hytterne Stovegolvet, Mjøllfjel, Nibebu og Hallingskeid.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Det var fint og mindede en del om DK

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Vær åben :)

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: At nordmændene har en aktiv hverdag

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Vælg housing gennem Sammen, vælg kurser for udvekslingsstuderende, tag afsted i forårssemesteret hvor vejret er bedre til fjeldture.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: De fjeldture man kunne tage og at vejret var godt i forårssemesteret.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Psykologisk Behandling var et kursus på 1,5 måned med nordmænd som havde kendt hinanden i 4 år, så det var lidt svært at komme ind i det sociale.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
